snippet.title: Car Screw Escape (by Eogames) IOS Gameplay Video (HD)
snippet.description:
App description:

Move the vehicles out by clicking on the different colored ones, use them to transport the screws on the model and gradually dismantle the complex structure. There is a limit to the number of vehicles of each type, how to skillfully arrange and make full use of these vehicles will be the key to your success. Challenge your intelligence and reaction, feel the thrill of dismantling, come and join this fun-filled game!

App Store Link:https://apps.apple.com/de/app/car-screw-escape/id6741799475?l=en-GB
